_about: Public-domain Matthew Simpson (1811-1884), Methodist Episcopal bishop, for the Word Hoard: his Funeral Address at the burial of President Lincoln (1865), A Hundred Years of Methodism (1876) and Lectures on Preaching (1879), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 52 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

msimpson-lincoln-funeral: Funeral address delivered at the burial of President Lincoln (New York, Carlton & Porter, 1865)
msimpson-hundred-years: A hundred years of Methodism (New York : Hunt & Eaton, 1876)
msimpson-lectures-on-preaching: Lectures on preaching, delivered before the Theological department of Yale college (New York, Nelson & Philips; Cincinnati, Hitchcock & Walden, 1879)

_excluded.msimpson-other: The Cyclopaedia of Methodism (1878, many contributors, he edited it); Our Martyr President (1865, many preachers)
